name: DESCENT
desc:
Descent into an abandoned facility and scavenge for objects to sell, meet the quota to avoid the worst !
scary / horror round-based multiplayer / co-op (up to 4 players (free) / up to 8 players with Bigger Lobby Pass / 50 players in private servers with Bigger Lobby Pass !

gameplay is based off Lethal Company.

scripts.title: Highlight ESP for the Monsters
scripts.features:
This highlights the monsters whenever a new one appears
You can execute it how many times you want. When you see nothing highlighted, that's because the monsters hasn't spawned yet
You also need to execute them every time you descent. Maybe?
scripts.script:
local function Fuckery()
    local folder = game.Workspace:FindFirstChild("Mobs")
    if folder then
        for _, object in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if object:IsA("Model") then
                if not object:FindFirstChild("Highlight") then
                    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    highlight.Parent = object
                end
            end
        end
    else
        print("Folder not found!")
    end
end

Fuckery()

while true do
    wait(2)
    Fuckery()
end

scripts.title: Highlight ESP for all Item Drops
scripts.features:
This highlights all the things you can pickup. 
It only highlights like ESP 
It does not tell what kind of item it is. 
You need to execute the script each time you descent


See for yourself.

Hopefully this helps you reach your quota
scripts.script:
local folder = game.Workspace:FindFirstChild("ItemDrops")
if folder then
    for _, object in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
        if object:IsA("Model") then
            local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
            highlight.Parent = object
        end
    end
end
